cards.title: Welcome to your board
cards.description: Edit this card, add project details, or drag it into another column.

cards.title: [Security]: Validate any leaks of API keys
[usability]: task description
cards.description: The task description should to watch and edit if needed

cards.title: [Security]: Validate client and project information vulnerabilities
cards.description: Review how client and project data is stored, exposed and accessed to find vulnerabilities.

cards.title: [Notifications]: Remind clients when an action is due
cards.description: Send reminders to clients when the due date of a client action arrives.

cards.title: [Bug]: Admin email does not change after updating .env
cards.description: Whenever the email is updated in the .env, the app keeps using the old email.

cards.title: [Email]: Client portal invitation email template
cards.description:
Draft the email template for inviting the client to the portal.

- [ ] Test send an email to guillermoj.obando@gmail.com

cards.title: [Invoicing]: Invoices based on Hacienda laws
cards.description:
Invoices must follow Hacienda laws. They should be sent to the client by email, or generated as a PDF the client can download.
Plan: Pro. It's a legal must-have for Costa Rican freelancers, so Pro must include it.

cards.title: [Payments]: Pay invoices from the client portal
cards.description:
Integrate a payment method linked to the invoice in the client portal, plus an option to download the document as PDF.
Plan: Max (candidate to move to Pro if Pro sells slowly). Pass ONVO fees through; don't absorb them.

cards.title: [AI]: Auto-create tasks from PDFs
cards.description:
Integrate AI to auto-create tasks from a PDF: take the task title from the PDF, create the task, and auto-assign it to the correct phase of changes. (This is to be worked out by itself.)
Plan: Max, metered (include N PDF imports per month).

cards.title: [Tenancy]: Add ownerId to tenant tables + migration 0010
cards.description:
Tenant = users.id. Add ownerId (uuid, FK users, not null) to clients, templates, services, service_bundles, brief templates and activity.
Migration drizzle/0010_tenant_owner.sql: add the column as nullable, backfill it with the current admin's id, then set NOT NULL. Change the clients email unique index to (ownerId, lower(trim(email))).
Projects, tasks, invoices and files inherit the owner through clients -> projects.

Done when:
- [ ] pnpm db:migrate runs clean on a copy of prod
- [ ] existing data still loads for the current admin

cards.title: [Tenancy]: requireUser middleware with userId in context
cards.description:
Turn requireAdmin (src/server/middleware.ts) into requireUser and put userId on the Hono context. Keep the 10-minute inactivity rule and trustedOrigin.

Depends on: ownerId migration.

cards.title: [Tenancy]: Scope every /admin query by owner
cards.description:
Every /admin/* route in src/server/app.ts must filter by ownerId directly, or by joining through clients.ownerId for projects, tasks, invoices, phases, files, briefs and problem reports.
This also covers dashboardData, service-catalog, templates and the R2 key paths.

Done when:
- [ ] a grep finds no unscoped select, update or delete on tenant tables

cards.title: [Tenancy]: Owner-aware cron jobs and portal
cards.description:
runFileCleanup, retryProblemReportNotifications and the scheduled task emails must resolve the owner (sender name and business) per project.
Portal (/portal/:token) emails should use the freelancer's businessName instead of a hard-coded brand.

cards.title: [Tenancy]: IDOR test suite (user A vs user B)
cards.description:
Seed two users, then check that user A gets 404 when trying to GET, PATCH or DELETE any of user B's clients, projects, tasks, invoices or files.
This is the gate for opening registration.

cards.title: [Register]: Extract seed into provisionAccount()
cards.description:
Move the services, bundles, default templates and brief templates seeding from scripts/seed.ts into src/server/provisionAccount.ts(userId).
Both seed.ts and register call it. It must be idempotent.

cards.title: [Register]: POST /api/auth/register endpoint
cards.description:
Add registerSchema to src/schemas/api.ts: name, businessName, email, password (min 8), acceptTerms (must be true).
Reuse hashPassword, the session cookie creation and the rate limiter from /auth/login.
In one batch: create the user, call provisionAccount, and create a free subscription.
Answer duplicate emails the same way as success, without revealing whether the account exists.

cards.title: [Register]: Register page /register
cards.description:
Register.tsx, following the Login.tsx pattern, with EN/ES strings in src/i18n.
Add links between Login and Register, and point the Landing CTAs to /register.

cards.title: [Register]: Email verification
cards.description:
email_verifications table (userId, tokenHash, expiresAt). Send it through sendEmail (Resend) in EN/ES.
Block checkout until the email is verified.

cards.title: [Register]: Forgot / reset password flow
cards.description:
password_resets table holding the token hash, with a 1-hour expiry and single use.
/forgot and /reset pages. Revoke all of the user's sessions after a reset.

cards.title: [Register]: Account settings + delete account
cards.description: Change name, businessName and password. Deleting the account cascades the DB rows, deletes the R2 objects under the owner's prefix and cancels the ONVO subscription.

cards.title: [Plans]: Define plans and limits (src/lib/plans.ts)
cards.description:
Plans are a constant: pro / max (open source = self-hosted, no plan), each with { id, name, priceMinor per currency (CRC, USD), onvoPriceId, limits: { clients, activeProjects, storageMb }, features }.
Prices (see docs/pricing-tiers.md): Pro $30/mo or $300/yr; Max $100/mo or $1,000/yr. Max is the anchor: Pro is the plan we want most people on.
Limits: Pro ~15 active clients, 5 GB storage; Max unlimited clients, 50 GB.
Features: Pro = templates, service catalog, briefs, documents, invoices, Hacienda e-invoicing, emails, problem reports, reminders. Max = Pro + portal payments (ONVO), AI task import (metered), white-label/custom domain, team members, priority support.

cards.title: [Plans]: subscriptions table + getActivePlan()
cards.description:
Columns: userId (unique), planId, status (trialing|active|past_due|canceled), onvoCustomerId, onvoSubscriptionId, currentPeriodEnd, cancelAtPeriodEnd, timestamps.
getActivePlan(userId) falls back to free when the subscription is canceled, expired, or past the grace period. Add a unit test.

cards.title: [Plans]: Enforce limits (402 PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED)
cards.description:
Check limits on POST /admin/clients, POST /admin/projects and file uploads (storage).
The UI shows an upgrade prompt linking to /billing. Downgrades never delete data; they only block new creates.
Also gate features by plan (e.g. requirePlan('max') for portal payments, AI import, white-label) with the same 402 + upgrade prompt.

cards.title: [Checkout]: Spike ONVO Pay API (test mode)
cards.description:
Confirm against the ONVO docs: customers, recurring subscriptions or prices, hosted checkout or payment links, webhook event names, the signature header, and CRC/USD support.
Create test keys and record the findings in this card.

cards.title: [Checkout]: ONVO client src/server/onvo.ts
cards.description:
A small fetch client with no SDK: createCustomer, createSubscription / createCheckout, cancelSubscription, verifyWebhook.
Secrets ONVO_SECRET_KEY and ONVO_WEBHOOK_SECRET go in wrangler secrets and src/env.d.ts.

cards.title: [Checkout]: POST /api/billing/checkout
cards.description:
Body { planId, currency }. Reuse the ONVO customer if one exists, otherwise create it, then return the hosted checkout URL.
Block the request if the subscription is already active on the same plan, and require a verified email.

cards.title: [Checkout]: Billing page /billing
cards.description: Shows the current plan, status and renewal date, usage against limits, upgrade/downgrade, cancel at period end, and payment history.

cards.title: [Checkout]: Pricing section on Landing + /pricing
cards.description:
Plan cards come from src/lib/plans.ts, with a CRC/USD toggle. The CTA goes to /register?plan=pro, which leads to checkout after verification.
Anchor layout: three cards, Free (self-host) | Pro | Max. Pro sits in the middle, highlighted, with a "Most popular" badge and the main CTA. Show annual as "$25/mo billed yearly". Max lists agency features so it looks like a real plan.

cards.title: [Billing]: ONVO webhook endpoint (auto-assign plan)
cards.description:
POST /api/webhooks/onvo, kept outside trustedOrigin and the auth middleware. Verify the signature.
Event mapping:
- payment succeeded / subscription active -> status=active, planId, currentPeriodEnd
- payment failed -> past_due (grace period N days)
- canceled -> cancelAtPeriodEnd=true

cards.title: [Billing]: Idempotency table billing_events
cards.description:
Store each ONVO event id with a unique constraint. A replayed event is a no-op that returns 200.

Tests:
- [ ] replaying an event is safe
- [ ] a bad signature returns 401
- [ ] each event type changes the plan as expected

cards.title: [Billing]: Daily cron reconcile + downgrade
cards.description:
Extend the scheduled handler in src/worker.ts (cron 0 18 * * *). Move expired or canceled subscriptions to free when the period ends, and move past_due to free when the grace period ends.
Optionally re-fetch the status from ONVO in case a webhook was missed.

cards.title: [Billing]: Billing emails (activated, failed, downgraded)
cards.description: Send through sendEmail (Resend) in EN/ES, following the renderOnboardingEmail pattern.

cards.title: [Launch]: Shared rate limiter (KV / Durable Object)
cards.description: The login rate limit is kept in an in-memory Map per isolate. Move it to a shared store, and use it for login, register, forgot password and checkout.

cards.title: [Launch]: Terms of Service + Privacy Policy pages
cards.description: EN/ES pages, linked in the footer and the register form. Store acceptedTermsAt on the user.

cards.title: [Launch]: Production config (domain, Resend DNS, origins)
cards.description:
Update APP_URL and ALLOWED_ORIGINS in wrangler.toml. Set up SPF/DKIM for the Resend domain.
Switch ONVO to live keys and register the webhook URL. Schedule encrypted backups.

cards.title: [Launch]: Security review + E2E smoke test
cards.description:
Run /security-review across the tenant scoping and the webhook.
Smoke test on staging:
- [ ] register
- [ ] verify email
- [ ] free plan is assigned
- [ ] checkout (ONVO test)
- [ ] webhook upgrades the plan
- [ ] pro limits apply
- [ ] cancel -> downgrade at period end

cards.title: [Launch]: Prepare the open-source repo
cards.description:
Publish the open-source core as a fresh repo (new git history): clients, projects, phases, tasks, client portal, basic files, en/es, dashboard. Single-admin.
Strip Pro/Max features (templates, briefs, documents, invoices, emails, problem reports...) or move them to a private repo / ee/ folder.

Done when:
- [ ] gitleaks/trufflehog scan is clean
- [ ] AGPL LICENSE + README self-host guide
- [ ] builds and runs without Pro code
